caption: Mukesh Art is building a premium airport media channel for brands that want visibility where attention is already high. From airport approach boards to in-terminal digital screens, Rajkot Airport Media x Mukesh Art brings outdoor, DOOH and backlit inventory into one serious campaign platform. Follow for inventory drops, campaign ideas and availability updates.

The Digital Screen Network gives brands motion-led visibility across the airport journey: arrival belts, security hold area, check-in and exit movement. Built for launches, retail campaigns, premium services and regional brands that need repeated recall inside the terminal. DM Mukesh Art for digital screen package availability.

Some brands need to be seen before the passenger enters the terminal. The Landmark Outdoor Boards cover airport approach and exterior movement with big-format static presence suited to real estate, jewellery, healthcare, auto, hospitality and premium local campaigns. Ask for AD-2 to AD-6 board options.

Portrait screens work where passengers pause: cafes, lounges, gates, check-in areas and arrival movement. The Vertical Display Network is made for product-led campaigns where the creative has to feel premium, close-view and easy to notice. DM for Package 3 vertical display details.

Backlit media is for brands that want permanence, not rotation. Security clearance and laptop workstation zones create close-view visibility in high-dwell spaces, making them strong for BFSI, healthcare, education, SaaS and premium service categories. Ask for backlit availability and location photos.

A stronger airport campaign is not only one screen or one board. Hybrid Journey Plans combine digital motion with static permanence across approach road, check-in, security, gates and arrival. The result is a campaign that follows the passenger journey instead of waiting in one corner. Share your campaign goal. We will suggest the right airport media mix.
